svg.title: A call for actor ID 123 routed to the service instance that holds it
svg.desc: On the left, three dashed boundaries stacked, captioned Instance 1, Instance 2 and Instance 3, each holding a green hexagon named Service code over the actor type it hosts, a hexagon carrying the Dapr logo, and a small table of actor types and partitions. Instance 2 shows Actor ID 123 created. In the middle, a filled panel named Dapr Placement service holding the same table larger, with a dashed line to a fourth boundary on the right captioned Caller, whose service reads Call Actor ID 123. A run leaves the caller, passes below the stack and arrives at Instance 2. Two steps below: the caller’s sidecar hashes the actor type and ID 123 and looks it up in its cache; the call goes straight to the instance that table names.

g.text: Client code calls actor ID 123 for actor type MyActor1

text.tspan: The Dapr instance hashes the request for ID 123 to a
Dapr instance (partition) and looks this up in the local cache
Client call for actor ID 123 sent to the Dapr instance
